description: The linked array list's twin of the fault at lib.zig:3731, on inputs/linked-header-above-tree, a file with no byte damaged: its clone's header says 41 and its tree holds 31. An iterator from position 35 starts in the last leaf with 17 left over, which goes into the leaf's index unchecked (lib.zig:3800), and the first next panics at lib.zig:3873: index out of bounds, index 17, len 16. Positions 36 to 40, and -6 to -1, do the same with 18 to 22, and 31 to 34 give nothing. The port raises InvalidBTreeNode at the iterator (SCRIPT-FORMAT.md section 11), so this runs with --allow-port-differences.
